faqs.q: Are your window installers BCA certified in Singapore?
faqs.a: Yes. All our window installers are certified by the Building and Construction Authority (BCA). Under Singapore law, all window replacements and repairs must be executed by BCA-approved window installers. We handle mandatory HDB/BCA notification paperwork.

faqs.q: Can I replace my toilet door without hacking the existing wall tiles?
faqs.a: Yes, our Slide & Swing and aluminium bi-fold door systems are custom-fabricated to fit your existing door frame sub-assembly or can be overlaid with sleek aluminium sub-frames, requiring zero hacking of your delicate bathroom tiles.

faqs.q: How effective are double-glazed acoustic windows against MRT train noise?
faqs.a: Extremely effective. Standard single-pane glass only reduces noise by 20dB, leaving screeching train tracks clearly audible. Our laminated double-glazed acoustic windows reduce sound by 38dB to 42dB, cutting perception of train and highway rumble by up to 80%.

faqs.q: Do you supply fire-rated main entrance doors with official CoC certificate?
faqs.a: Yes. All our 1/2 hour and 1 hour fire-rated timber main entrance doors come with an official Certificate of Conformity (CoC) label issued by accredited testing bodies, satisfying all Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) and HDB requirements.

faqs.q: Can SPC vinyl flooring be laid directly over my old ceramic tiles?
faqs.a: Yes. In 95% of cases, click-lock SPC rigid core planks can be laid directly over clean, sound ceramic, homogenous, or parquet floors without messy hacking. We verify door clearance and plane door bottoms slightly if required.

faqs.q: Is your parquet floor sanding process truly dust-free?
faqs.a: Our Bona industrial belt sanders utilize two-stage cyclone HEPA containment filters that capture 99% of airborne wood dust directly at the cutter head. Minimal household cleaning is required after our sanding crews finish.

faqs.q: What is the difference between carpet tiles and wall-to-wall broadloom carpet?
faqs.a: Modular carpet tiles (typically 50cm x 50cm) allow easy access to underfloor electrical wiring and let you replace individual stained tiles without redoing the entire room. Broadloom carpet provides a seamless, plush hotel finish across large continuous spaces.

faqs.q: How often should natural marble floors be re-crystallized or polished?
faqs.a: For typical residential apartments, a light diamond crystallization every 2 to 3 years is sufficient to maintain showroom mirror clarity. High-traffic commercial reception areas benefit from an annual polishing cycle.

standards.title: 100% Solid Marine-Grade Plywood (Zero Chipboard)
standards.desc: Many mass-market contractors use cheap chipboard or MDF that swells, sags, and rots within 2 years in Singapore's humid climate. Renovation Contractor SG uses only heavy-duty solid plywood carcasses that withstand heavy loads, moisture, and pests for decades.

standards.title: Seamless 1mm ABS Edge Banding
standards.desc: We apply 1mm high-pressure ABS edge banding using computer-controlled hot-melt technology. This eliminates unsightly black glue lines, protects corners from chipping, and prevents peeling over time.

standards.title: Authentic Blum & Austrian Hydraulic Hardware
standards.desc: All doors and drawers come standard with genuine Blum BLUMOTION soft-close hinges and concealed drawer runners tested for 200,000 opening cycles with lifetime operational reliability.

faqs.q: Do you build custom internal configurations for wardrobes?
faqs.a: Yes. Every drawer height, hanging rod level, jewelry tray, trouser rack, and hidden safe compartment is built to your exact custom specifications.

faqs.q: Can I choose my own laminate brand (e.g. Lamitak, Jennings, EDL)?
faqs.a: Yes. We fabricate with all major Singapore laminate distributors including Lamitak, Jennings, EDL, Formica, and Admira with over 1,000+ catalog finishes.

faqs.q: How long does custom carpentry fabrication and on-site assembly take?
faqs.a: Factory fabrication takes 2 to 3 weeks following final site measurements, while on-site installation and alignment take just 3 to 5 days.

hero.title: Architectural False Ceilings, Cove Lighting & Partitions
hero.subtitle: Saint-Gobain Certified · Heavy Galvanised Steel Framing
hero.desc: Conceal exposed electrical trunking, air-conditioning pipes, and concrete beams with precision drop ceilings, ambient LED cove pelmets, and acoustic drywall partitions.

standards.title: Heavy-Duty Galvanised Metal Stud Framework
standards.desc: We never use cheap thin metal channels that bend under ceiling weight. Renovation Contractor SG frames ceilings with heavy-duty galvanised steel furring channels spaced at strict 400mm centers, suspended with zinc-coated threaded steel rods anchored to concrete slabs.

standards.title: Saint-Gobain Gyproc Fire-Rated Boards
standards.desc: We use genuine Saint-Gobain Gyproc plasterboard certified for fire safety and environmental air quality. Boards are precision-cut with bevelled edges to create invisible seams after compound taping.

standards.title: 3-Coat Joint Taping (Zero Hairline Cracks)
standards.desc: Hairline cracks in false ceilings occur when joints are skimped. We embed high-tensile fiberglass perforated joint tape across all seams and apply three feathered coats of premixed joint compound, followed by fine mechanical sanding.

faqs.q: How much ceiling height will I lose with a false ceiling in an HDB flat?
faqs.a: A standard flat false ceiling typically drops between 100mm to 150mm (4 to 6 inches) from the existing concrete soffit. This provides ample cavity space to hide downlights, wiring, and air-conditioning conduits while maintaining comfortable 2.4m–2.6m headroom.

faqs.q: Can false ceilings support heavy ceiling fans or designer chandeliers?
faqs.a: Yes, but heavy fixtures require dedicated reinforced timber or steel structural backing plates anchored directly to the concrete ceiling slab above.

faqs.q: Will moisture cause the bathroom false ceiling to sag or grow mold?
faqs.a: In wet areas like bathrooms and kitchens, we use specialized green-core moisture-resistant plasterboard sealed with anti-fungal sealer paint.

hero.title: Professional Painting, Skim Coating & Surface Restoration

processes.title: 100% Furniture Wrapping & Floor Protection
processes.desc: Before opening a single can of paint, our team covers all flooring with heavy-duty corrugated cardboard and wraps sofas, electronics, and cabinetry in electrostatic dust-protection plastic sheets.

processes.title: Surface Scraping, Plaster Patching & Skimming
processes.desc: We scrape off loose flaking paint, dig out old nail anchors, patch wall cracks with high-adhesion putty, and skim uneven patches until every square inch is glass-smooth.

processes.title: Alkaline-Resistant Sealer & 2 Finish Coats
processes.desc: We apply a full coat of alkali-resistant sealer to block moisture and ensure color brilliance. Followed by two thick, uniform topcoats of authentic Nippon Paint applied with precision microfiber rollers.

faqs.q: How long does whole-house painting take for a 4-room or 5-room HDB flat?
faqs.a: A complete whole-house repainting (living hall, dining, all bedrooms, kitchen, and both bathrooms) takes 2 to 3 working days with our dedicated team of 3 painters.

faqs.q: Is Nippon Odour-Less paint truly safe to sleep in on the same night?
faqs.a: Yes. Genuine Nippon Odour-Less All-In-1 emits zero harmful VOCs and has virtually no smell, allowing families with infants or elderly members to reoccupy bedrooms on the same day.

faqs.q: What causes paint to bubble and peel on ceiling surfaces?
faqs.a: Peeling and bubbling usually occur when paint was applied without an alkaline-resistant sealer or from high humidity in bathrooms. We scrape back to the plaster, apply moisture sealer, and repaint.

faqs.q: How long does a full 4-room or 5-room HDB renovation take?
faqs.a: A full turnkey renovation for a 4-room or 5-room resale flat typically takes 6 to 8 weeks, while BTO flats with no existing hacking usually take 4 to 6 weeks.

faqs.q: Do you provide transparent milestone progressive payments?
faqs.a: Yes. Payment is split into clearly defined milestones: deposit on permit approval, hacking completion, wet trades/tiling completion, carpentry delivery, and final balance after joint defect inspection.

faqs.q: Are HDB permit submissions and corridor protection included?
faqs.a: Yes. All statutory HDB and BCA submissions, lift padding protection, and corridor cardboard wrapping are managed and included by our team.

hero.title: Precision Masonry & Master Tiling Services
hero.subtitle: BCA Certified Tilers · 100% Solid Buttering (Zero Hollow Tiles)
hero.desc: Flawless laser-aligned tile laying for floors, feature walls, balconies, and bathrooms using premium polymer adhesives and anti-mold epoxy grouting.

steps.title: 100% Solid Buttering (Zero Hollow Tiles)
steps.desc: Inexperienced contractors use 'spot bonding', leaving empty hollow pockets beneath tiles that crack when stepped on. We apply full-coverage combed polymer mortar on both floor and tile back, ensuring 100% solid compaction and zero hollow sound ('drumming').

steps.title: Laser Cross-Line Optical Alignment
steps.desc: Every single row is aligned using 3D multi-line laser leveling instruments. Grout spacing is locked to ultra-tight 1.5mm–2.0mm tolerances with reusable leveling clips to eliminate tile lippage completely.

steps.title: 45-Degree Mitred Edge Finishing
steps.desc: Instead of cheap PVC plastic corner trims that discolor and peel, our craftsmen wet-cut tile edges to exact 45-degree angles for seamless, high-end architectural stone junctions on kerbs and ledges.

steps.title: Anti-Mold Epoxy Grouting (Mapei)
steps.desc: Standard cement grout absorbs water, turning black and moldy in humid Singapore bathrooms. We seal joints with two-part epoxy grout that is 100% waterproof, stain-proof, and easily wiped clean.

faqs.q: What is hollow tile 'drumming' and how do you prevent it?
faqs.a: Hollow tile drumming occurs when tile adhesive doesn't achieve full coverage under the tile. We back-butter 100% of the tile surface with heavy-duty polymer adhesive to guarantee solid bedding.

faqs.q: What is the difference between cement grout and epoxy grout?
faqs.a: Cement grout is porous and absorbs dirty mop water, causing mold and yellow stains. Epoxy grout is completely non-porous, waterproof, and chemically stain-resistant.

faqs.q: Can I supply my own tiles purchased from Hafary or Soon Bee Huat?
faqs.a: Yes. Many of our clients select their tiles from Hafary, Soon Bee Huat, or Lian Seng Hin. We calculate tile quantities with 10% wastage allowances and handle transport collection.

faqs.q: How long does a complete toilet renovation take in Singapore?
faqs.a: A single toilet overhaul takes 7 to 9 working days. If doing both master and common toilets concurrently, completion takes 10 to 14 working days.

faqs.q: What is the 24-hour water ponding test?
faqs.a: After applying the dual-layer waterproofing membrane, we plug the floor traps and fill the bathroom floor with 25mm of water for 24 hours to verify zero seepage through the concrete slab.

faqs.q: Do you assist with HDB bathroom permit applications?
faqs.a: Yes. In Singapore, hacking bathroom floors requires mandatory HDB renovation permits. We handle all paperwork and submit drawings directly.

faqs.q: Why do older HDB resale flats require a complete electrical rewiring?
faqs.a: Older flats built before the 1990s use degraded PVC or rubber cabling that deteriorates over decades. Modern households place heavy power loads (induction hobs, dishwashers, multiple aircon units) that older wiring cannot safely handle.

faqs.q: Will electrical cables be concealed inside the walls or run on surface trunking?
faqs.a: In HDB flats, wiring on hollow brick walls can be completely concealed by wall chasing. On load-bearing reinforced concrete shear walls, we use neat, paintable ultra-slim PVC casing.

faqs.q: Do you provide EMA Single Line Diagrams (SLD) and CS/3 testing endorsement?
faqs.a: Yes. All our electrical installations are supervised by EMA Licensed Electrical Workers (LEW). We perform insulation resistance testing and submit certification paperwork.
